documents.title: Diabetes Follow-up
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Bowels still loose most days, though he has figured out which meals set it off. Eating smaller amounts more often. Lightheaded spells after meals still happen; he sits down and they pass. Cathing twice daily, no infections. Feet the same, acetaminophen at night.
Sugars 150-220 fasting.
O: Vitals as charted. Abd soft. Feet: no wounds, callus-free.
A/P
- DM2 with neuropathies (peripheral, autonomic, bladder). A1c today. Continue metformin, glargine 24, lispro scale. Reviewed carb counting handout.
- Neurogenic bladder on CIC, stable.
- Epilepsy, no events.
RTC 4 months.

documents.title: A1c
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: A1c came back a little lower than December. Kidney labs normal. Keep going with the smaller meals and the logs.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Same-day Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Texted this morning, seen same day.
S: Two days of burning when he cathes and when he voids, more frequent urge. Urine cloudier. No fever, chills, flank or back pain. No blood.
O: Afebrile, vitals as charted. No CVA tenderness. Abdomen soft, mild suprapubic tenderness.
UA: LE and nitrite positive, WBCs present.
A/P: UTI in a man on intermittent self-cath. Culture sent. Cephalexin 500 BID x 7 days. Reviewed catheter hygiene and single-use technique. Call if fever or flank pain.

documents.title: Urine culture result
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Culture grew E. coli, sensitive to cephalexin. Called pt: already feeling better, finishing the course. No fever.

documents.title: Missed appointment
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Called re: missed visit yesterday. He mixed up the date. Will fold the diabetes check into his wellness visit in September. Labs to be drawn then.

events.reason: Annual wellness visit and diabetes check

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Annual Wellness Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Subsequent AWV plus diabetes follow-up (missed July).
HRA reviewed. No falls. Independent. PHQ-2 0. Still hasn't named a health care proxy; says he will.
Diabetes: fasting 140s-200s. One UTI in June, treated. Diarrhea comes and goes; lightheaded after big meals less often since he eats smaller portions.
Meds unchanged: metformin 1000 BID, glargine 24 u, lispro scale, phenytoin 300, acetaminophen prn.
Exam: vitals as charted. Heart RRR. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft. Feet: no lesions, reduced monofilament and vibration at toes, ankle jerks diminished.
Plan: A1c, CMP, CBC, lipids, urine albumin, phenytoin level. Flu shot today. Bivalent COVID booster at pharmacy this fall. Eye exam letter requested from his optometrist.
RTC 4 months.

documents.title: Your wellness labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs look about as expected. A1c still in the mid-8s. Phenytoin level is therapeutic, kidneys and liver normal, no protein in the urine. See you in January.

documents.title: Immunization record from pharmacy
documents.author: pharmacy
documents.body: Bivalent COVID-19 booster given at community pharmacy.

documents.title: Diabetic eye examination
documents.author: optometry
documents.body:
Dilated eye exam performed 12/02/2022.
Visual acuity correctable to 20/20 OU. Anterior segment unremarkable. Fundus: no diabetic retinopathy either eye, no macular edema. Optic nerves healthy.
Allergies on file: none.
Recommend repeat dilated exam in 12 months.
Optometry

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Same-day Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Burning and urgency since the weekend, same as June. No fever, no flank pain, no blood.
O: Afebrile. No CVA tenderness. Mild suprapubic tenderness.
UA positive for LE and nitrite.
A/P: Second UTI in 7 months, both while self-cathing. Adding recurrent UTI to the problem list. Culture sent; cephalexin 500 BID x 7 days, worked last time. Went over hand hygiene, fresh catheter each time, cathing on schedule so volumes don't run high. If they keep coming, back to urology.

documents.title: Urine culture
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Your urine culture grew the same type of bacteria as last time and the cephalexin covers it. Please finish all 7 days.

documents.title: RE: Urine culture
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Will do. Already better. Thank you.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Diabetes Follow-up
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Reports he went back to endocrinology on 2/24 and signed up for a research study of a new diabetes pill, randomized, so he doesn't know if he's getting the real drug. The study team gives him the tablets and checks labs on their own schedule. He was told to keep all his usual diabetes meds the same. We have no letter from endocrinology or the study; he has a consent copy at home and will bring it.
UTI in January, cleared. Bowels: some good weeks, some bad.
O: Vitals as charted. Feet unchanged.
A/P
- DM2: A1c today. Continue metformin, glargine 24, lispro. Noted trial participation; investigational product not on our med list since it's blinded and dispensed by the study. Asked him to tell us of any study-related lab results.
- Recurrent UTI: none since January.
RTC 5 months for AWV.

documents.title: Refills
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Need refills on the pen needles and the test strips, and the catheter company says they need a new order.

documents.title: RE: Refills
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Pen needles and strips sent. Catheter order signed and faxed to the supply company today.

documents.title: Annual Wellness Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
AWV.
HRA reviewed. Drives, does his own shopping and cooking. No falls. PHQ-2 1 (a few days of low energy, not mood).
Still in the endocrinology study, no news from them. Never brought the consent copy; reminded.
No UTIs since January. CIC twice daily.
Exam: vitals as charted. Heart and lungs normal. Feet: skin intact, monofilament reduced at toes, ankle reflexes diminished.
Screening up to date (colonoscopy 2021 normal, next 2031). Eye exam: last letter 12/2022, due; he says he'll book.
Flu today. Updated COVID shot at pharmacy when available.
Labs: A1c, CMP, CBC, lipids, urine albumin, phenytoin.
RTC 3 months.

documents.title: Wellness labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: A1c is 8.3%, about where it has been. Kidneys, liver, blood counts and urine protein are all normal. Phenytoin level is in range.

documents.title: Immunization record from pharmacy
documents.author: pharmacy
documents.body: 2023-2024 COVID-19 vaccine administered.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Diabetes Follow-up
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Sugars about the same. Admits he's been less careful this fall. Not much exercise. No lows. Bowel symptoms on and off. Feet unchanged.
O: Vitals as charted.
A/P
- DM2, A1c stuck in the 8s for two years. Talked frankly about where this goes and what would help: regular walking, cooking more, logging sugars before meals so the lispro scale is used right. He wants to try on his own before any med change. A1c today.
- Eye exam still not received this year; reminder given.
RTC spring.

documents.title: A1c
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: A1c 8.5%. Let's see what the walking and cooking plan can do by spring.
